day_shape: 59 items: Rubio tells Fox Iran weighing denuclearisation and Hormuz deals, IDF announces killing of October 7 Nukhba commander plus three Gaza operatives and 1,200 Hezbollah structures razed by 401st Brigade, heavy regime Arbaeen logistics cycle (1.8m pilgrims), nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: US-Iran diplomacy and Trump attack claims
threads.summary: Rubio told Fox News Iran is considering deals on denuclearisation and the Strait of Hormuz, while Times of Israel reported Trump claims a pact would reopen Hormuz and end Iran's nuclear threat. Iranian military officials denied Trump's claim that Iran asked the US to halt attacks, and Defa Press said Trump had cancelled a planned strike.

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes and October 7 operative killed
threads.summary: The IDF announced the killing of Salem Jamal Abd al-Rahman Abu Labad, a Hamas Nukhba cell commander who infiltrated Kibbutz Nir Oz on 7 October 2023, alongside a Maghazi Battalion commander. Separate strikes killed three operatives from Army of Islam, Palestinian Islamic Jihad and another group, per IDF and Times of Israel military correspondent.

threads.label: Southern Lebanon strikes and 401st Brigade withdrawal
threads.summary: Times of Israel military correspondent reported five Lebanese soldiers lightly injured by an Israeli strike in Kafra, while the Jerusalem Post said 401st Brigade soldiers completed their mission having destroyed 1,200 Hezbollah structures over eight months. Defa Press and IRIB alleged Israeli forces used phosphorus munitions in the Irtifaʿat ʿAli al-Ṭāhir area.

threads.label: Gaza disarmament and Board of Peace
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported Palestinian Islamic Jihad has agreed to the disarmament deal set out by Trump's Board of Peace, while a Gaza source affiliated with Israeli-backed militias said the plan will not be implemented. Times of Israel reported Mohammad Dahlan claimed Jared Kushner assured him Israel would end Gaza strikes, a post deleted within two hours; the IRGC vowed the plot to disarm Hamas would fail.

threads.label: Arbaeen pilgrimage logistics
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press reported 1.8 million Arbaeen pilgrimage passports issued, 70 vans providing free transport from Tehran's Azadi Square to Mehran border, and Bushehr provincial offices closed Wednesday to ease pilgrim transit. Commander Radan said traffic fatalities fell 40 percent versus the same period last year, and Khamenei's office posted an Arbaeen message invoking Iran's martyred leader.
